target: UTM-bundled QEMU/HVF, AArch64 PCI graphical guest, one vCPU, disposable writable RedSea VirtIO fixture
commands: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-redsea-current-8181de3.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --probe-raw-redsea-geometry present

QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-redsea-repair-current-8181de3.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --probe-raw-redsea-geometry repair
verified: The disposable fixture mounted a bounded writable RedSea volume as drive D.
TOSConfig selected CD source mode, and TOSMisc DiskCheckAll skipped source-only C before checking mounted RedSea D without throwing.
The clean-volume stock DiskCheck returned zero; raw geometry, bounded read/write/restore, unmount, terminal recovery, and zstatus failed=0 passed.
The repair fixture contained a nested SUB/KEEP.ZC file and a separate allocated orphan cluster. Stock DiskCheck reported one consistency error and freed only the orphan allocation.
Read-back confirmed the nested directory and file remained allocated while the orphan bit was cleared; a second clean scan returned zero and zstatus reported failed=0.
scope_note: Automated UTM-bundled QEMU/HVF checks on disposable VirtIO RedSea storage. This does not establish FAT32 behavior, all RedSea repair cases, physical Pi SD behavior, or live UTM UI behavior.
